title: docs(tonewood): FPL GTR-282 values for covered species (tranche 2)
intent: Tranche 2 of the tonewood library verification: add FPL GTR-282 (2021) shrinkage and mechanical tables as a reference, check every density/SG/Janka/MOE/MOR/shrinkage and derived acoustic value for FPL-covered species against it strictly, correct the documents and the prose built on the old numbers, and resolve open issues O-04, O-06 (except Granadillo), O-07 and O-09.
behavior_change: none - documentation, a reference CSV, and two standalone scripts under scripts/ that the application does not import. wood_species.json and every other data file, route, schema and workflow are untouched.

diff_articulation.what_changed: docs/reference/fpl-gtr282 (CSV + README with SHA-256 provenance); scripts/extract_fpl_gtr282_tables.py; scripts/check_tonewood_fpl_values.py; 619 checked cells in 13 docs now equal FPL (418 rewritten by --fix, the top-woods doc by hand), prose claims rewritten where the numbers changed rankings; CITES_STATUS.md adds Bagtikan (not listed) and the 2026 EU Annex D Shorea s.l. listing; VERIFICATION_LOG.md C-11 and updated open issues.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Tranche 1 left FPL-covered species on unsourced or regression values (e.g. pignut hickory Janka 902 vs FPL 2,136 lbf; mahogany MOE 11.97 vs 10.3) and several rankings were wrong as a result. The checker makes the FPL attribution re-runnable.

commands_run: metric vs FPL inch-pound twins (5-3b/5-4b/5-5b): 1,397 values checked, 1,390 agree; 7 are FPL-internal inconsistencies (listed in the README)
py -3.11 scripts/check_tonewood_fpl_values.py --summary -> 619 cells checked, 0 mismatches, exit 0
stale-number scan of non-table lines for every replaced value -> only unchanged values and thresholds remain
Species+ (speciesplus.net search API): Parashorea / malaanonan -> 0 records; Dipterocarpaceae -> 186 species in 7 genera, cites_listing NC, eu_listing D (Reg. (EU) 2026/1383, effective 2026-06-29)
wood-database.com: ovangkol Janka 1,330 lbf; guanacaste 470 lbf; african-padauk 1,710 lbf; no page for Platymiscium yucatanum
